$comment: Project-owned overrides for the managed quality gates (merged by gate id). This repository is the corpus itself: its TypeScript lives in yarn workspaces with no application frontend, so the shipped frontend gates are mapped onto the checks the publish workflow runs. The corpus verification (yarn workspace @cratis/ai-verification run verify) is part of the test script's package check and runs in CI; the override keeps each gate a single argv command.

gates.description: yarn workspace @cratis/harness-setup run check — type check and adapter plan verified
yarn workspace @cratis/ai-verification run check — zero TypeScript errors
yarn workspace @cratis/ai-verification run verify — corpus structure, catalog, agents, and skill scenarios verified
yarn workspace @cratis/ai-verification run test — zero failures
